name: Aarti Industries Ltd
title: Aarti Industries Ltd - 524208 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 volume-led utilisation gains and two new long-term contracts offset by West Asia disruption, Zone IV delay, and a rising net debt of about INR 4,300 crore (~3.6x EBITDA); FY27 capex cut to INR 700-800 crore.

utilisation.quote: the capacity utilization continued to remain high, preserving our wallet share with the global customer

capex.quote: Our capex for FY27 is expected to be in the range of INR 700 crore to INR800 crore as we continue our journey to optimize capex and maximize the returns.

triggers.label: FY27 capex INR 700-800 crore
triggers.quote: Our capex for FY27 is expected to be in the range of INR 700 crore to INR800 crore

triggers.label: NCB pricing improving on China anti-involution
triggers.quote: we have seen that kind of happening now as the Chinese anti -involution plays out, where the margin profile has definitely improved, including pricing

triggers.label: Working capital up, net debt INR 4,300 crore
triggers.quote: Working capital requirements expanded during the quarter, driven primarily by significant elevation in raw material prices, causing an uptick in net debt as well as interest expenses.

triggers.label: Zone IV delayed 3-4 months
triggers.quote: These projects were delayed by 3 to 4 months on account of labour constraints

triggers.label: Energy volumes down 4% QoQ
triggers.quote: The volumes for the quarter were down 4% quarter -on-quarter, primarily driven by lower exports to the Middle East

guidance.quote: Our capex for FY27 is expected to be in the range of INR 700 crore to INR800 crore
the internal target is to reduce the net debt levels from the current levels in the current financial year

I think the entire Zone IV, which is a combination of multipurpose plant, calcium chloride plant, and there are 5 chemistry blocks, different chemistry blocks. I think the entire capex will get commissioned during FY27.
we like to target 55 to 60 days kind of levels
the tax rate will be in the range of around maybe 9% to 14%, 15% kind of stuff lateron

prior_guidance_check.quote: In line with the guidance given, the capex for the year was at about INR 1,125 crore.
These projects were delayed by 3 to 4 months on account of labour constraints

red_flags.label: Net debt rising, working capital stretched
red_flags.quote: a good part of this, maybe around INR 250 crore to INR300 crore is purely because of the working capital increase

red_flags.label: Unhedged USD loan FX loss
red_flags.quote: we have roughly around $87 million of an FX loan, which is unhedged and is open

evasions.quote: Typically, we will not share asset block by asset block capex.
I would not like to comment. Again, we do not talk about revenue.

evasions.topic: Industry share of MMA supply removed
evasions.quote: Difficult to comment. We do not have answer for that.
